entry.summary: Downer Hawke’s Bay would like to give you notice that under contract to the Napier City Council, cleaning of the silt/material generated by the flood event in the parking area and footpath on Marine Parade between Browning Street through to Coote Road, Napier is scheduled for this Thursday morning - 19/11/2020.
